title: Self-hosted IBM Plex Mono 400/500/600 + latin-subset Inter: ~80KB total, OFL-prefixed, @font-face in the hand preamble
body:
ROUND 1 - no dependencies. Charter GR8. (1) Fetch genuine IBM Plex Mono Regular/Medium/SemiBold TTFs (google/fonts repo ofl/ibmplexmono - the gstatic mirrors serve the same source) and latin-subset each to woff2: python3 -m fontTools.subset <ttf> --unicodes='U+0000-00FF,U+0131,U+0152-0153,U+2000-206F,U+20AC,U+2122,U+2212' --flavor=woff2 --output-file=... (measured ~13.3/13.5/14.2KB). fontTools 4.60.2 is installed (python3 -m fontTools.subset; the pyftsubset binary is at ~/Library/Python/3.9/bin/, off PATH). (2) Latin-subset cloud/priv/static/fonts/Inter-var.woff2 with the same unicode set and REPLACE IT IN PLACE (same filename; 223,892 -> ~40,644 bytes measured; cache is presently no-cache so no busting needed). (3) Commit the subset binaries (repo precedent: committed woff2, no build-time step). Total *.woff2 budget in cloud/priv/static/fonts/: <= 120,000 bytes (measured 81,668). Name the mono files IBMPlexMono-{Regular,Medium,SemiBold}-latin.woff2. Verify each is real woff2 (wOF2 magic + fontTools TTFont load). (4) Hand-author the three IBM Plex Mono @font-face blocks (weights 400/500/600, font-display: swap) in app.css's PREAMBLE - BEFORE the '/* BEGIN GENERATED: tokens */' marker at ~line 18. The emitter owns no font code by design; do not touch design/emit.mjs or design/tokens.json. (5) Update --mono's stack in app.css's hand-authored block (~line 345 and its dark redeclaration) to lead with "IBM Plex Mono" - all 37 var(--mono) consumers retint for free. (6) OFL hygiene: rename cloud/priv/static/fonts/OFL.txt to Inter-OFL.txt and add IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt (api/'s prefixed convention - the dir now hosts two families). Do NOT touch router.ex (the fonts cache-header fix rides gr-w1-operator-me-flag). Keep index.html unchanged. GATE: python3 -c "import glob,os; s=sum(os.path.getsize(p) for p in glob.glob('cloud/priv/static/fonts/*.woff2')); print(s); assert s<=120000" && test "$(grep -c '@font-face' cloud/priv/static/app.css)" -eq 4 && cd cloud/priv/static && node --test __app.test.mjs 2>&1 | grep -q '^# fail 0' && node __css_check.mjs > /tmp/cc-fonts.log 2>&1; test "$(grep -c '^FAIL' /tmp/cc-fonts.log)" -le 112

<!-- barkpark:acceptance:start -->
### Acceptance criteria
- [x] 4 committed woff2 files (in-place Inter subset + 3 Plex Mono weights), total <= 120KB, each verified real woff2 (wOF2 magic; TTFont glyph-count sanity in evidence)
- [x] @font-face blocks live in the app.css preamble only, before the GENERATED marker; grep count of '@font-face' in app.css = 4
- [x] --mono stack leads with IBM Plex Mono in both light and dark declarations; no per-consumer edits needed (var(--mono) untouched at call sites)
- [x] OFL files prefixed: Inter-OFL.txt + IBMPlexMono-OFL.txt present, bare OFL.txt gone; license text is the genuine OFL from the font sources
- [x] __app.test.mjs 438/438; __css_check.mjs error count not increased over the 112 baseline
- [x] PR merged to main (lead closes this criterion on merge)
<!-- barkpark:acceptance:end -->

Task: gr-w1-fonts
